rows.what: RM_LongShade BiomeDef, build/assembly wiring, FlowWorks dependency and Baroque Biomes composition; old About claims of complete standalone independence are not current proof.
rows.why: Composition and definitions let the biome load; do not repeat the stale standalone claim.

rows.what: Sand/Soil fertility bands, occasional walkable RM_DeepSand from FlowWorks, stock dry weather/diseases and actual dewfringe-sprig caravan forage.
rows.why: Sand, rock, buildable soil and walkable DeepSand are the ground, without a special hazard.

rows.what: Native roster and positive spawn densities; current XML, rather than old counts, supplies Bokka, Khorrak, Dunejelly, Gulloth, Oreclaw, Gloomcast, Chorn, Gennok, Tebbra, Dakkra, Pirrik, Mirrak, Harrok, Skiralim, Vrekka, Sippra, Tazzok, plus optional Thraia/JOE_Landopus and Qorrax. All shipped PawnKindDefs and custom bodies are included in content accounting.
rows.why: Keep actual membership, including patch additions; no evictions or new creature before diet audit.

rows.what: Ordinary food, combat tools, taming/trainability, body/life stages, breeding, meat/leather and egg/hatching products on the shipped animals; Chorn/Gennok pack flags and Dakkra stationary radiator-fin graphic. Does not imply caravan whitelist acceptance or bespoke behaviour from every description.
rows.called_by: Vanilla animal think trees, butchery and training
rows.why: Ordinary feeding, reproduction, combat, taming and products supply the encountered wildlife.

rows.what: This folder also still defines elsewhere-cast Ommok (Miasma), TruffleMole (LeaningScrub), Ulgga/Vosska and UltrissPad (Stillsand), their products and Vosska buried/swimming art. Their presence is shipping content, not a request to move them back.
rows.why: Preserve content owned here but already cast elsewhere; it is not extra LongShade fauna.

rows.what: Utinni patch adds the SW Bestiary animal cast and canon chakroot/hubba-gourd plants to RM_LongShade with real FindMod/target-node guards. Free-tier roster survives alongside it; campaign content is not required for a standalone RM story.
rows.why: Existing patch-added cast remains; enrichments do not substitute for a working free-tier food web.

rows.what: Ordinary Maidenbloom/heart, Pavecrust/chemfuel, Shadespire/wood/shade, SurraGrass, VellaraBloom, Thrannagourd/food and visible Vorrel plant; no bespoke propagation inferred.
rows.why: Ordinary forage, graze, fuel, wood and ornamental plants supply local life. Behavioural promises are split below.

rows.what: Leachmoss competition and Venomvine contact venom
rows.called_by: BiomeDef wildPlants opts into EnvironmentalHazards; shared spawn gate and CompContactVenom
rows.why: Secondary fertility pressure and poison are not required for sparse ordinary flora or shade crossings.

rows.what: Dewfringe, sprig harvest and shade-fraction wild-spawn gate, armed Harmony postfix; toggles fall back to ordinary fertility/terrain spawning. This filters spawn candidates, not an ongoing existing-plant growth/death check.
rows.why: Delete the spawn rim and the player loses the living boundary used to read established shelter; keep sprigs and rim recruitment, not instant death on shadow change.

rows.what: Vorrel lethal ingestion, shade-stagger and corpse germination
rows.called_by: RM_Vorrel direct ingestion plus RM_VorrelFruit outcome -> RM_VorrelBrood -> shared ShadeStagger
rows.why: A gut-parasite reproduction chain is a second signature; ordinary visible Vorrel remains, with no ingestible fruit in defaults.

rows.what: Prepared Vorrel dish, stove recipe, euphoria and thought
rows.called_by: RM_Vorrel_Recipes.xml stove recipe -> RM_VorrelSeedDish outcomes and thought
rows.why: A special drug-food preparation loop is not required for ordinary forage.

rows.what: Khorrak steel/slag eating and ordinary nutrition (vacstone output split out).
rows.called_by: RM_CompMetalEater; vanilla eating blocked for this species
rows.why: Life: deleting metal eating leaves a retained mineral feeder unable to obtain its food; vacstone production is split out and deferred.

rows.what: Pinned sky, glow, shadow colour and sun vector configured on LongShade; shared PinnedSun types implement it. Geometry and rendering need joint verification; per-biome legacy clamps remain.
rows.why: Remove the fixed dayside sky and directional shadow picture and this band loses its land identity; use tile geometry, remove biome sun clamps.

rows.what: Shared directional/static/roof/gear/moving/light shade layers, exposure into vanilla heat and body-size scaling. Current LongShade opts in with overhead/30 C legacy fields; that is implementation present, NOT compliance with the later 55 C geometry-only ruling.
rows.why: Signature needs truthful exposure from shared geometry into ordinary Heatstroke; existing legacy fields do not meet the ruling.

rows.what: Shared patch graph, wild-animal sun escape, rest while hot, rim pause and bounded dash with size/endurance budgets; faction, mental-state, roping and race exemptions. Not proof of blanket control over every need/combat job or patch social hierarchy.
rows.why: Without evolved rest, bounded crossing and recovery, shade is decoration rather than the owner-chosen rest/dash/rest experience.

rows.what: Shared per-cell sun path-cost customizer and colonist return-range display; does not itself establish autonomous work refusal or safe round trips.
rows.why: Signature needs shared sun-cost routing for actual needs, not only idle wander; does not promise LongShade-specific colonist forecasting. Overlay is split out.

rows.what: Existing shared parasols and tent/roof shelter, stuff-dependent depth including Mirrak hide. Gear and heat toggles belong to the shared kit; no new LongShade-specific heat model.
rows.why: Player-created shelter is necessary to change a crossing; only existing parasols and any roof, under the same geometry as natural shade.

rows.what: Study/crossing research discounts
rows.called_by: EnvironmentalHazards RM_ShadeLessons_Sources.xml adds study comps; CrossingLanded event subscriber; research availability patch
rows.why: Ordinary always-available gear research already supplies shelter; removing the discount preserves access.

rows.what: Dakkra opts into shared heat-burst predator and fatigue/retreat machinery; own stationary fin-state graphic. Ordinary hunt selection still comes from the underlying AI, so a comp's presence is not acceptance of the no-pursuit promise.
rows.why: Life and signature: removing Dakkra fatigue/retreat would leave a retained hunter pursuing beyond thermal endurance and defeat bounded native crossings. Keep burst/recovery, not an invulnerable speed buff.

rows.what: Mirrak perceived-shade lure without real cooling, shared ambush and readable drag-mark loss sign, hide with shade-cloth bonus. Data and generic mechanism are distinct from art or fairness acceptance.
rows.why: Deleting the Mirrak deception would remove the owner-chosen reason to distrust a shadow. It is a false destination in this same shelter/exposure chain, never actual cooling.

rows.what: Gloomcast body is a registered moving shade source with configured height/radius/depth; shared grid must cool occupants and clear old positions. Body size is currently 24 in its race def, not older docs' 16.
rows.why: Deleting the mobile shelter removes the signature change of refuge while an animal moves; it must clear old cells and end on death/despawn.

rows.what: Terrain filter-feeding on Sand/SoftSand with nutrition payout and dung leavings, implemented by shared job giver/driver.
rows.why: Life: deleting sand filter feeding leaves the retained giant with only scarce ordinary grazing despite its desert feeder anatomy. Keep nutrition and plain leavings, not seeding bonuses.

rows.what: Dung plant growth boost, Maidenbloom seeding and young-animal creation
rows.why: Fertilisation and population creation are an additional ecology loop; mobile shelter and feeding work without them. Plain dung sign split below.

rows.what: Pirrik and opted-in Chorn/Gennok/Tebbra seek a shadow-caster using shared FollowClose. Following is intermittent because needs/tree gates, proximity and job expiry intervene.
rows.why: Life and signature: without intermittent following Pirrik cannot use its evolved moving refuge, and the already-selected Chorn/Gennok/Tebbra lose the visible use of mobile shelter. No new followers or permanent escort guarantee.

rows.what: Pirrik and Skiralim flight-related race/stat definitions plus shipped graphics; Skiralim texture set includes directional flying frames under its retained Skarrok texture path. No flight motion or scarp-specific attack accepted.
rows.called_by: MaxFlightTime stat; flight race flags and graphics
rows.why: Life and standing flight ruling: deleting real flight from Pirrik/Skiralim would leave fictional flyers walking. Keep locomotion and state graphics, not new scarp combat.

rows.what: Procedural wreck crossing
rows.why: Hand-built shelter and natural patches already support crossings; a curated salvage route is extra encounter content.

rows.what: LongShade road cart/speeder placement and local salvage package
rows.called_by: CrawlerRoad wreck list and linkDefs fallback; Wreckage weathering/salvage; Acoustic payload cart target
rows.why: Road-specific rewards are not necessary land; shared ordinary wreckage remains a dependency.

rows.what: Dead-crawler terminus injection and hull registration
rows.why: A specific inhabited destination is a narrative extra, not the shelter rule.

rows.what: Long Carry remains, supplies and novel placement
rows.why: A gear-gated salvage encounter is not required to make gear useful.

rows.what: Shipfall timed animal gathering
rows.called_by: Biome RM_ShipfallCommonsExtension; ThinkTreeDef insertion -> RM_JobGiver_ShipfallCommons; MapComponent clock
rows.why: Scripted admission and attraction are independent of animals using real shade.

rows.what: Pilot-console dispersal and arrival messages
rows.why: An exit ceremony is needed only by the deferred gathering system.

rows.what: Old lee-side heap seeding
rows.why: Searchable surface archaeology adds a reward loop beyond shade travel.

rows.what: Search designation, Mining job and spent-once loot
rows.why: A bespoke search job does not feed or shelter the first release.

rows.what: Vrekka heap building and tending
rows.why: Scavenging remains an ordinary animal role without constructing loot containers.

rows.what: Mapgen clean-lair markers
rows.called_by: extraGenSteps -> RM_GenStep_CleanPatches after Animals -> RM_CompCleanPatchTell inspect
rows.why: A static former-lair marker is not a truthful current warning; Mirrak must be readable directly.

rows.what: Tollok stationary-shade infestation
rows.why: Charging a parasite rent for resting is another hazard and fights thermal recovery if unbalanced.

rows.what: Lure awning building and nearby-game counter
rows.why: It duplicates ordinary roof shelter; the counter does not create a necessary experience.

rows.what: Herd stampede-for-roof incident and runner orders
rows.why: A colony invasion incident is separate from ordinary native thermal survival.

rows.what: Harrok stationary shadow-strip ambush
rows.called_by: Harrok comp -> Scan -> InShadowStrip/HarrokCanStrike; overrides idle with Wait
rows.why: Mirrak already makes a shelter destination dangerous; another special strike geometry is extra. Harrok remains as a mobile corpse scavenger with real body shade.

rows.what: Returning-clan hull claim and tow
rows.why: Negotiating ownership of a narrative hulk is a second story system, not shade physics.

rows.what: Smoke-haze incident, dimming and start/end messages
rows.called_by: RM_SmokeHazeFront -> plain GameCondition; RM_ShadeHaze -> shade-grid/render/audio consumers
rows.why: A timed crossing holiday is not necessary weather or thermal recovery. Optical length amplification split below.

rows.what: Camera heat beds, pre-dash calls and far footfalls
rows.called_by: Biome RM_HeatSoundscapeExtension; Dash calls TryHerdCall; Gloomcast RM_CompProperties_Footfalls
rows.why: Thermal health, shade and ordinary animal sounds already communicate the chain; bespoke mixing is extra.

rows.what: Bespoke biome arrival letter
rows.called_by: EnvironmentalHazards biome arrival hook; LongShade configuration if present; validation walk historical promise
rows.why: A custom welcome is not needed when inspect and ordinary health communicate danger; scanner payload split out as a standing dependency.

rows.what: Master plus per-owned-feature bool switches, Scribe persistence, searchable/collapsible grouped scroll UI, scope labels and section reset from shipped defaults; links explain shared-kit switches. No numeric experience tuning fields are exposed here.
rows.why: Land, life, signature and standing settings ruling: deleting the screen removes control of shipped features and separation from untested extras.

rows.what: Shipped plant/animal/item/wreck/midden/awning/worldmap assets, custom bodies, life-stage graphics and descriptions. PNG existence is implementation evidence only; no new visual judgment, canon check or owner-kept-art replacement.
rows.why: Land, life and signature: without visible species/shelter and honest inspect text the player cannot read threats or shelter; preserve all owner-kept assets, including deferred content.

rows.what: Static/live validation suite, pure C# kernel fuzz harness, planted-defect Python selftests, HullTow/ShadeExtras/Stampede static-call staging probes and Python clause drivers, plus offline historical follower replay. These are capabilities of the test machinery, not accepted gameplay.
rows.why: Existing regression/probe tools are dependencies of evidence, not gameplay or passing bars. Keep useful kernels; future extras checks do not refuse this version.

rows.what: Campaign swimmer journey, rooting and tenancy evacuation
rows.why: A once-per-map migration/settlement event is its own chain and belongs after the basic shelter cycle. No Sarlacc engine redesign.

rows.what: Plain Gloomcast feeding/voiding leavings with no growth or population effect
rows.why: Life: deleting the leavings removes the already-ruled visible trace of a giant feeding; ordinary filth must be decoupled from seeding toggle, not a separate scar.

rows.what: Periodic vacstone output from Khorrak
rows.why: Industrial material production is unnecessary to a living mineral feeder.

rows.what: Mirrak hide bespoke shade-depth bonus (ordinary leather stays)
rows.why: Parasols and roofs already provide player shelter; best-cloth collection is an extra progression reward.

rows.called_by: Temperature build menu -> ShadeGear lee mode; ship_contributions.py check
rows.why: A special shade device duplicates roofs and fights the later keep-only-parasols-and-roofs ruling. Owner-kept art remains untouched.
